behaviors.description: Observe AppStream refresh through the public timestamp file.
behaviors.preconditions: Independent AppStream repository, configured remote, two refreshes separated in time.
behaviors.expected: Default and explicit native architectures return the same retained GFile; each refresh updates that file's mtime within its measured time interval, even after releasing the remote object.

mappings.rationale: Independently bounded refresh times establish that the returned public file tracks refresh attempts and outlives its remote object.

surface_assertions.rationale: Returned native/default timestamp files match and update on each refresh after the remote is released.
